dialogues.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
dialogues.text: Hey, it's you guys. Thanks for what you did before.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: You showed me what I was lacking. I still have a lot of training ahead of me.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: I seem to have been too focused on a single element when it comes to my Fungi. Although your Fungi are also centered around a particular one that's stronger than the rest, your composition is a lot more balanced than mine.

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: In other words, the talent that you guys possess is much more balanced and stable than mine. I still have a lot to learn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're being too modest! You and Gusto-Frosto are great too!

response.speaker: Baron Bigfoot
response.text: See you around. I hope to chat again soon!
